messages:
marie: Quick sync — we need to lock the candidate funnel for the Catalyst beta. target: 12 active partners (mix of mid-market & startups). timeline: invite list by next Tue.

tom: +1. Can we split 6 enterprise / 6 startups? That helps test Dedicated & Hosted flows.

alejandra: I can pull a shortlist from existing pilots & sales leads. Do we want to prioritize customers on Dedicated right now? :thinking_face:

marie: Prefer a mix — at least 3 Dedicated-first, 3 Hosted-first. We need customers who can commit to weekly check-ins and instrumenting quality signals.

samir: On instrumentation — we'll require the approved SDK hook and sample prompts. Can we include an integration checklist in the invite so partners know dev effort?

katie: Draft invite copy in #product-marketing? Quick note: include data handling options (VPC/private), expected SLOs, and time commitment.

marie: Good call. Draft invite for feedback: "Join Catalyst beta: 8-week program to validate latency/cost controls, rollout policies, and custom quantization. Weekly 1-hr check-ins + two technical deep dives. Participation grant + credits." Thoughts?

tom: Sounds fine. Add explicit acceptance criteria: 1) integrate Redwood SDK + logs, 2) run 3 evals from our prompt set, 3) share perf traces for first 100k tokens.

alejandra: Suggest we include a short screening form. Minimal fields: company, primary use-case, infra (VPC/on-prem/hosted), SLA need, expected monthly tokens, PM/engineering contacts, willingness to run canary test. Example form snippet:

```
- Company name
- Primary product use-case (1-2 sentences)
- Deployment preference: Hosted / Dedicated / Private
- Monthly token estimate (banded)
- Can participate in weekly calls? Yes/No
- Contact (name + email)
```

samir: Also add a checkbox for "agree to share perf logs" and a toggle for NDA. Legal needs that.

marie: Good. For prioritization, we'll score candidates by: technical fit (30%), impact (30%), operational readiness (20%), willingness to iterate (20%). Aim to invite top 20 to get 12 acceptances.

katie: I'll prep the invite + landing page draft tonight. Can someone share the candidate list by EOD Mon? @alejandra? :pray:

alejandra: Yep, will export CRM leads and existing pilot contacts. Expect spreadsheet by Mon 18:00 PT.

engbot: Reminder: onboarding doc updated — /docs/catalyst-onboarding v0.2. Please review before sending invites.

marie: Next steps: (1) alejandro list, (2) katie draft invite, (3) tom/samir draft screening criteria + instrumentation checklist. Sync Wed 9am PT to finalize invites. Thanks everyone :rocket:
